text: Hey you... Just take it easy, alright?
You may have killed the strongest raider around, but there are still hundreds more.
zh: 你也许杀了这一带最强的掠夺者，可后面还有成百上千个。

text:
Take a look at the entrance.
In just a minute, this room will be crowded with raiders and you'll be dead.
zh:
看看入口那边。
用不了一分钟，这屋子就会挤满掠夺者，而你就死定了。
